info.name: FCL BOT Integration API
info.description: Postman collection for the FCL BOT Integration API. Sales documents are staged into Business Central imported tables; master data and posted sales invoice history are read-only.

Stages a single BOT order into BC Imported Orders. If SQL_WRITE_TEST_* is configured, the same document is also staged to the test write target and the response includes a targets array. POST /api/imported-orders also accepts a raw array of order objects or an object wrapper { "orders": [...] } for batch staging.

body.raw:
{
  "orders": [
    {
      "documentType": "order",
      "company": "{{company}}",
      "externalDocumentNo": "BOT-BATCH-100045",
      "sellToCustomerNo": "{{customerNo}}",
      "shipmentDate": "2026-06-22",
      "salespersonCode": "{{salespersonCode}}",
      "shipToCode": "{{shipToCode}}",
      "shipToName": "{{shipToName}}",
      "customerSpecification": "No onions",
      "pdaOrder": false,
      "externalOrderUrl": "https://bot.example.com/orders/BOT-BATCH-100045",
      "lines": [
        {
          "lineNo": 10000,
          "itemNo": "{{itemNo}}",
          "quantity": 12,
          "unitOfMeasure": "{{uom}}",
          "productSpecification": "Vacuum packed"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "documentType": "order",
      "company": "{{company}}",
      "externalDocumentNo": "BOT-BATCH-100046",
      "sellToCustomerNo": "{{customerNo}}",
      "shipmentDate": "2026-06-22",
      "salespersonCode": "{{salespersonCode}}",
      "shipToCode": "{{shipToCode}}",
      "shipToName": "{{shipToName}}",
      "customerSpecification": "No onions",
      "pdaOrder": false,
      "externalOrderUrl": "https://bot.example.com/orders/BOT-BATCH-100046",
      "lines": [
        {
          "lineNo": 10000,
          "itemNo": "{{itemNo2}}",
          "quantity": 5,
          "unitOfMeasure": "{{uom}}",
          "productSpecification": "Tray packed"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
